description:
Goal
Remove the native-local repr-mismatch planner introduced during fz-hwn.19.5. Native lowering should consume the BackendTail call-return-flow fact and emit the corresponding IR form directly.

Design
CallReturnFlow::Tail lowers to Term::TailCall and must already have exact caller/callee return contract equality. CallReturnFlow::Continue lowers to Term::Call with a generated continuation whose entry payload is the settled ReturnPayload position and whose body returns lanes through the caller ExecutableReturn position. CallReturnFlow::Deliver keeps the existing ResumePayload continuation path. Term::ReturnLanes remains the terminal for returning settled lanes through the body return position.

Removal target
Delete return_lane_continuation_for_local_callee or collapse it into a dumb constructor that takes explicit ReturnPayload/caller-return positions. Remove tests and docs that say native lowering routes mismatched tail returns. Codegen must only enforce invariants; it must not choose between Tail and Continue.

Signal
Use fz2 after building the binary: target/debug/fz2 --log-telemetry ... run --dump types=... --dump activations=... --dump materialized=... --dump abi=... --dump backend=... --dump native=... --dump fnir=... fixtures2/behavior/multi_relay.fz. The dumps must show the ReturnPayload-backed continuation before codegen and no native TailCall whose caller/callee return contracts differ. Telemetry/tests must prove producer return, ReturnPayload, and caller return positions use the intended ShapeId relationships.

Required edits
src/compiler2/jobs/native.rs, src/compiler2/native_codegen/* only where invariant messages/consumption need cleanup, src/compiler2/drive_test.rs, docs touched by fz-hwn.19.5.

Checks
Focused native tests, fz2 dump/telemetry fixture run, cargo fmt --all, cargo check --all-targets, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings, and cargo test --lib or the agreed compiler2 matrix.
title: Transport return-flow: make native lowering consume return-flow facts
